contract.name: Winter 2026/27 local travel agent rates contract (Market 01 – all markets)
contract.tax_note: Rates are inclusive of all government taxes & services; nett and non-commissionable
contract.child_policy_text: Children below 2.99 years – Free of charge. 3-11.99 years sharing parent's room (Maximum 2 children) USD 30 per child (Extra bed is provided on request – Included in above rate).
contract.guide_policy_text: Guide Rates 40 USD per room per night HB. All Guides will be allocated at the Guides quarters or Other suitable alternate accommodation.
contract.cancellation_text: Cancellation Both Hotel (FIT Booking): 21 Days & above – No Cancellation fee; 15-20 Days – 50% charged on the basis booked; 14 Days and below – 100% charged on the basis booked. Cancellation Both Hotel (GIT Booking): 30-21 Days – 50% charged on the basis booked; 20 Days and below – 100% charged on the basis booked.
contract.terms_text: Rates are inclusive of all government taxes & services. The above rates are non-Commissionable. The above rates cannot be published on any WEB/ONLINE channels. The number of occupants in a room will depend on the social distancing policy given by the government. In the event of a change in the stipulated government Taxes & Services, the rates will be posted on the respective agent. All above rates are in US $, nett and non-commissionable, applicable for above market only.
contract.notes: Fax-style chain sheet for Avenir Holidays, one rate block per hotel per period; only Half Board is priced, with "BB Reductions per person USD 05/-" and "Lunch Supplement per person USD 15 | Child 50% discount" as the meal deltas (per person per night). The document subject prints "WINTER 2025/26" although the period line, the file name and the e-mail all say winter 2026/27 — a typo in the sheet, the dates inside the rate tables are unambiguous (01/11/2026 … 30/04/2027). Hayleys' covering e-mail of 25 Aug 2026 calls these "special winter rates instead of the previously quoted rates" and the PDF is named "Winter SPL 26_27"; entered as a contract because the document titles itself "LOCAL TRAVEL AGENT RATES CONTRACT" and carries the complete set of clauses. If it is meant to override a standing Amaya contract, switch plan_type to special_offer and raise the priority. The cancellation block is headed "Both Hotel" although the sheet covers three hotels — read as applying to all of them. The Christmas / New Year supplements are printed without dates; entered on the usual gala nights 24 and 31 December 2026. Amaya Beach – Passikudha, room category "Standard Rooms", one rate for the whole period 01/11/2026 – 30/04/2027 (no seasons); the five higher categories are priced as that room plus a supplement per room per night. The New year supplement is USD 70 here, not 95 as at Lake and Hills.
contract.source_file: WINTER RATES 2026/2027 -AMAYA RESORTS & SPA CHAIN — Avenir Holidays_- Winter SPL 26_27.pdf
